# Affordi

> Affordi is a private calculator that converts a price into the work time needed to afford it.

People enter their take home pay, the times and days they work, and currency, then a price that is paid once, every workday, weekly, monthly, or yearly. Affordi shows the work time it takes, when it will have been earned working from now, and its share of take home pay. An earnings page counts what has been earned today in real time, both around the clock and during working hours, shows how much of this month's pay has been worked for, and breaks pay down per second, minute, hour, day, week, month, and year. A monthly page adds up what is paid each month in work time and as a share of take home pay, with what is left each month and per day. It holds bills that change each month, such as electricity or water, entered month by month with a chart of the last twelve months, and fixed costs that stay the same, such as rent, loans, insurance, or subscriptions, with how much of each loan is paid and how much is left to pay. Calculations, settings, fixed costs, and bills stay in the browser, and no account is required.

## Site

- [Affordi calculator](https://affordi.pages.dev/): Use the calculator in any supported language and install it as a progressive web app.
- [Affordi source and documentation](https://github.com/vladanp/affordi): Review the source code, README, development commands, and release history.
